dedupe_keys.name: space data network sdn and spaceaware io

description: Space Data Network is an open, decentralised network for distributing space data, including a space object catalogue, space weather, events and warnings, as well as software and services, with every record digitally signed by its source. It is built by Edgesource Corporation, published on GitHub under the DigitalArsenal organisation, because each operator today downloads the same large files from separate sources with no proof of origin. Radars, telescopes, operators, universities and nations can publish orbits, observations and warnings in open standard formats, free or for sale; the network combines them into one catalogue that lists its inputs and method so anyone can rerun it, and supports collision avoidance. Coverage is all tracked objects in orbit. Format and access: the SpaceAware.io browser portal, a desktop app, and node software for macOS, Windows and Linux plus a JavaScript SDK, released as beta builds on GitHub. Licence: MIT for the node, app and SDK, with some libraries under Apache-2.0 or a non-commercial licence; freemium where publishers sell data. Caveats: beta software, and catalogue quality depends on who publishes. It supports hazard exposure analysis of space traffic. Related catalogue records are the CelesTrak GP and SATCAT data and the LeoLabs visualisation platform.
